property_summary: For every valid input where transfer completes (does not revert), the reference C.transfer always returns true, but the mutant may return false for some inputs — so the returned boolean is always true in the reference but sometimes false in the mutant.

For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always attempts all calls to the target caddress and returns true if none revert; the mutant may return after the first successful call, causing transfer to return true even when later calls would revert (or to return false earlier) — so the reference never returns early while the mutant can.
